headline: Is he ever going to be ready for real commitment?
note: generated from REVIEW-new-voice.md — not a wired draft

Look at his table. It's out in the open, on the grass.
You asked if he'll ever be ready for real commitment. I can't read him — what catches me is what's laid out on that table.
And yet nothing has been settled. And you're the one left waiting on an answer.
Something turns up at the point where it would settle. I don't think any of it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's got hold of it…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The backs told you nothing, and you took the one held by a single rope.
Look at the rope. One ankle, and the rest of him hangs loose.
You asked if he'll ever be ready for real commitment. The hold is what I'm reading — one line, and nothing else.
Still, nothing has been settled. And the waiting has landed on you.
The hold here is firm, and nothing about it eases. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what that is…
c: You turned the Fool. Face down, all three, and you chose the one already stepping out.
Look at his feet. One has lifted, and the other is following.
You asked if he'll ever be ready for real commitment. The step here is being taken as we look at it.
But nothing has been settled. And you're the one asking when it will be.

Let me look closer at what's sitting there…
